results.description:
Ứng dụng Trip.com cho phép bạn dễ dàng đặt vé máy bay, khách sạn và vé tàu với mức giá cực thấp. Trở thành thành viên Trip.com ngay để khám phá những ưu đãi mới nhất và ưu đãi dành riêng cho thành viên, giúp bạn tiết kiệm nhiều hơn!
 
• Vé máy bay: Vé máy bay nội địa và quốc tế với mức giá thấp nhất có thể và dễ đặt
• Khách sạn: Hơn 1,4 triệu khách sạn, khu nghỉ dưỡng và căn hộ trên khắp thế giới để thỏa sức lựa chọn - bạn có thể đặt bất cứ loại chỗ nghỉ nào mà mình nghĩ đến!
• Vé tàu: Dễ dàng đặt vé tàu tại Vương Quốc Anh, Đức, Hàn Quốc, Trung Quốc đại lục và Đài Loan

***Danh Sách Tính Năng Chi Tiết***
 
• Vé Máy Bay
 
【Tìm kiếm chuyến bay phù hợp nhất với bạn】Ứng dụng Trip.com cho phép bạn lọc kết quả tìm kiếm theo giá, thời gian bay, ngày đi, hãng hàng không hoặc số lượng điểm trung chuyển hoặc điểm dừng. Bạn cũng có thể chọn một hành trình nhiều chặng để có thể linh hoạt lựa chọn những thành phố đi và đến khác nhau. 
 
【Thông Báo Giá】Bạn không tìm được chuyến bay vừa túi tiền? Hãy thiết lập ngay thông báo giá thấp và chúng tôi sẽ thông báo cho bạn ngay khi vé máy bay hạ đến mức giá mục tiêu của bạn.
 
【Bản Đồ Giá Thấp】Bản đồ giá thấp bao quát toàn thế giới, từ châu Á, châu Âu và châu Mỹ cho đến châu Đại Dương và châu Phi. Bản đồ này thu thập các vé máy bay giá rẻ cho hơn 1.000 đường bay trên khắp thế giới, để bạn có thể dễ dàng bắt đầu chuyến phiêu lưu tiếp theo của mình.
 
【Kiểm Tra Trạng Thái Chuyến Bay】Nhập số hiệu chuyến bay để xem thông tin chuyến bay trong thời gian thực.
 
• Khách Sạn
 
【Bộ Lọc Tìm Kiếm Nâng Cao】Bạn có thể duyệt tìm hơn 1,4 triệu khách sạn trên khắp thế giới trên Trip.com. Bất kể bạn muốn lưu trú tại một căn hộ giá rẻ, một khách sạn 5 sao sang trọng, homestay ấm cúng hay khu nghỉ dưỡng với đủ loại tiện ích giải trí, bạn đều có thể dễ dàng tìm được cơ sở lưu trú phù hợp nhất với mình.
 
【Chúng Tôi Khớp Giá】Chúng tôi sẽ cố gắng hết sức để đưa ra mức giá tốt nhất cho bạn. Nếu bạn tìm được mức giá rẻ hơn ở nơi khác, chúng tôi sẽ hoàn tiền phần chênh lệch.
 
【Đánh Giá Thực Của Khách】Hơn 30 triệu đánh giá về khách sạn của các vị khách có thực sẽ giúp bạn đưa ra những quyết định sáng suốt hơn.
 
【Đặt Gói Vé Máy Bay + Khách Sạn】Đặt vé máy bay và khách sạn cùng nhau để tiết kiệm nhiều hơn cho chuyến đi của bạn. Bạn vẫn được bảo đảm có phòng khách sạn nếu chuyến bay bị dời lịch.
 
• Vé Tàu
 
【Vé Tàu Toàn Cầu】Bất kể bạn định đi tàu ở Trung Quốc đại lục, Đài Loan, Hồng Kông, Hàn Quốc hay Châu Âu (bao gồm Vương Quốc Anh, Pháp, Ý, Tây Ban Nha và Đức), bạn đều có thể tìm được thông tin chuyến tàu tương ứng trên trang web của chúng tôi.
 
【Đối Tác Chính Thức】Hệ thống của chúng tôi kết nối trực tiếp với thông tin chuyến tàu và cung cấp lịch tàu chạy kèm giá mới nhất tại thời điểm bất kỳ, cho phép bạn nhanh chóng tìm kiếm giá vé, giúp tiết kiệm thời gian và tiền bạc.

• Bảo Đảm Đi Lại
 
【Bảo Đảm Dịch Vụ 24 Giờ】Chúng tôi sẵn sàng hỗ trợ khách hàng 24/7 và cung cấp bảo đảm đặt chỗ hậu mãi, giúp bạn yên tâm trên mọi hành trình. Dịch vụ chăm sóc khách hàng giành giải thưởng của chúng tôi sẽ phục vụ chu đáo để trợ giúp mọi hành khách yên tâm bắt đầu hành trình của mình.
 
【Hỗ Trợ 24 Ngôn Ngữ】Đổi ngôn ngữ trong ứng dụng sang tiếng mẹ đẻ và dễ dàng quản lý tất cả các đơn đặt chỗ của bạn.
 
【Chấp nhận 31 loại tiền tệ và nhiều phương thức thanh toán】Chúng tôi hỗ trợ nhiều phương thức thanh toán khác nhau cho du khách quốc tế. Ứng dụng Trip.com chấp nhận tất cả các phương thức thanh toán phổ biến.
 
【Bảo Hiểm Du Lịch】Với gói bảo hiểm du lịch toàn diện của chúng tôi, bạn có thể yên tâm trên mọi hành trình.
 
【Phần Thưởng Dành Riêng Cho Thành Viên】Trở thành thành viên Trip.com để nhận các phần thưởng độc quyền, như Trip Coin từ chương trình phần thưởng, giúp bạn tiết kiệm nhiều hơn trong chuyến đi tiếp theo.
 
Tải ngay ứng dụng Trip.com để khám phá nhiều tính năng hơn và có trải nghiệm đi lại thật dễ dàng.

results.description:
Your travel passport, your world map and your photo albums, on your iPhone.
One stamp for every country you have been to, a map to tick off, a globe to spin, and your photos sorted by trip.
No account, no server: everything stays with you.

WHO IT IS FOR
For anyone who counts their countries, keeps old boarding passes in a drawer and would like to see, at a glance, where they have set foot. Tick a country off when you get home, write two lines, come back to it in ten years.

YOUR PASSPORT
• One page per country, with a hand drawn stamp and the outline of the country in the middle.
• The arrival date and the return date, written on the stamp.
• One photo per country, stuck on the page like a print, picked in one move from the trip's album.
• One note per country: a dish, a person, a moment.
• A cover you make your own: the colour, the ornament, your first name.
• Pages turn under your finger.

YOUR TRAVEL ALBUMS
• Souvenir sorts your photos and videos into albums on its own: one album per trip, with the place and the dates.
• At the top, the flags of your countries; below, your trips sorted by year.
• Add a photo you forgot, remove one that does not belong: nothing is ever deleted from your photo library.
• Everything happens on your iPhone: no photo is sent anywhere.

THE MAP AND THE GLOBE
• The world map: tap a country to tick it off, pinch to zoom, drag to roam, endlessly from east to west.
• Zoom all the way in to the smallest islands, with every country's name written on the map.
• A globe in relief that spins under your finger, from the whole planet down to the islands of the Caribbean.
• Your counter: how many countries, and your share of the world, out of the 195 recognised countries.
• Territories are drawn on the map too; they do not count towards the 195.
• In the list, every country carries its flag.

YOUR STATISTICS
• Your progress, continent by continent.
• Your travel days, added up.
• 30 medals to earn: from your first stamp to 150 countries, the six and the seven continents, Europe, Africa, Asia, the Americas and the South Seas, islands, landlocked countries, microstates, the four hemispheres, your long trips, your best years, ten years of travel, and even your photos and notes. Each one arrives full screen, with its own animation.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Widgets for your country counter, your filled in world map and your latest countries with their flags.

TO SHARE
A vertical 9:16 image, ready to post.

WHAT THE APP DOES NOT DO
• No account to create, no password, no server.
• Your countries, photos and notes stay on your iPhone and sync through your own private iCloud. Nobody else can reach them.
• You can export a full backup and import it back whenever you want.
• This passport is a keepsake, not an official document: it replaces no ID and grants no right.

Free. No subscription, no in app purchase, no ads.
Twenty languages, from English to Japanese.

A question, an idea: contact@simplibot.fr
Info and help: https://simplibot.fr/souvenir

Stampie is a passport-style travel journal and country tracker with 1,000+ collectible stamps, and new ones every month.
Made for travelers who notice borders have stopped giving passport stamps.

Every country you visit. Every wonder you see. Every memory worth keeping, in one place.

Argentina stopped stamping in 2022, Peru in 2023, and the EU's Entry/Exit System ends stamping across 29 countries by 2026. Memories deserve a place to live, even when the ink doesn't come.

Stamps are more than marks in a book. They're milestones, stories, and a personal bucket list. Stampie is a simple, visual way to track your adventures and celebrate where you've been. Think of it as your travel journal, reimagined.

Whether you're a digital nomad, a weekend traveler, or just want a beautiful travel diary, Stampie keeps your trips in one place.

———————————————————
BUILT FOR TRAVELERS 
———————————————————

• STAMP COLLECTIONS: Collect stamps across countries, cities, islands, continents, wonders, marathons, and more.
• EXPLORE & DISCOVER: See what's trending, browse editor's picks, and dig into every collection: countries, cities, wonders and more. There's always a new stamp to chase.
• TRIP JOURNAL: Add dates, titles, notes and photos to any stamp. Every stamp tells the story of the trip behind it.
• PERSONALIZE YOUR PASSPORT: Make it yours with more customization, custom covers, colors, and stickers, front and back (Pro).
• SHARE YOUR PASSPORT: Turn your travels into beautiful share cards for posts, stories, or your group chat. Share your whole passport, your map, or a single stamp.
• HOME WIDGETS: Pin your travels to your iPhone home screen with iOS widgets. Six layouts, one glance away.
• OVERVIEW STATS: See your countries, continents, latest stamp and first-ever stamp at a glance, with the flags of every country you've visited on your profile. Switch between UN-recognized countries and all countries with a tap.
• WORLD MAP: All your visited countries on a beautiful zoomable world map.
• COUNTRY MAPS: Fill in the states, provinces and regions you've visited on zoomable maps of the USA, Germany, Japan, Canada, Australia and the UK (Pro).
• FLAGS: Collect a flag for every country you visit and see how much of the world you've covered.
• REARRANGEABLE SECTIONS: Put what matters first. Your stats, your stamps, your map in the order you like.

———————————————————
WHO STAMPIE IS FOR
———————————————————

• Digital nomads tracking where you've worked from
• Backpackers ticking off bucket-list countries  
• Frequent flyers logging every trip
• Families building a travel scrapbook together
• Solo travelers documenting their journey
• Anyone with a passport (or memory) full of places

———————————————————
PRO MEMBERSHIP
———————————————————

Upgrade once, unlock everything. Forever.

• All extra collections (Wonders, U.S. States, U.S. National Parks, Marathons and more coming soon)
• Unlimited photos per stamp
• Passport & map customization
• Pro badge in your shareable travel profile
• Support independent developers

Try Stampie for free.

Xem và đăng ký

results.description:
Every trip tells a story. PASSPRT turns yours into a passport, collect one-of-a-kind stamps that capture where you’ve been and what it means.

Wherever you travel in the real world, PASSPRT gives you a uniquely designed stamp to mark it. Touch down in a new country, explore a new city, or visit a landmark, every place you go becomes part of your passport.

Unlike a photo library or a travel journal, PASSPRT verifies your presence. No fake check-ins. No stamps from your couch. Just a real, earned passport that grows every time you step out the door.


— FEATURES —

• Collect stamps for countries, cities, and places as you travel
• Verified stamps are earned in the real world — you have to be there
• Import past trips and add unverified stamps to your passport
• A clean world map of everywhere you’ve been
• Uniquely designed stamp art for every place
• Share your passport and individual stamps
• Discover places worth collecting across the world
• Anti-cheat built in — no driving past or flying over to unlock stamps
• Your passport is yours forever


— HOW IT WORKS —

Sign up with email, Google, or Apple
Travel somewhere — a new country, city, or landmark
Open PASSPRT and scan while you're there
A new stamp appears in your passport
Share it, or keep collecting


— FOR REAL TRAVELLERS —

PASSPRT is built for people who actually go places. Every stamp is earned. Every passport is unique. Every check-in happens on location.

Whether you're a weekend explorer, a backpacker crossing continents, or someone who simply loves their hometown, PASSPRT builds a passport that reflects where you’ve been and what it means.

results.description:
Passport Stamps turns your travels into a living map — and lets the people who traveled with you help fill it in, together, in real time.

A map you actually own
Every pin, every note, every photo lives in your own private iCloud — not our servers. There are no ad trackers, no account to create, and no company database standing between you and your travel history. Uninstall the app and your data is still exactly where it's always been: your iCloud.

Real collaboration, not just a shared view
Create a TripMap and invite your family. Everyone can add and edit locations at the same time — no "owner-only" restriction, no read-only guests. Edit the same trip at once and Passport Stamps detects the conflict and lets you resolve it, instead of silently dropping someone's changes. Sharing is free, for as many people as you like — there's no hosting bill standing between you and your family's map.

Built for how you actually travel
• Tap a country or state right on the map to mark it — real borders, not just a pin
• Track status per place: visited, want to go, lived there, or going again
• Attach photos and notes to any location
• Curated checklists for U.S. National Parks and UNESCO World Heritage Sites
• Coverage stats: percent of the world visited, countries, states, and continents, counted automatically
• "Year in Passport": a personal annual recap of everywhere you went
• Export your map, or your stats, as a shareable image or PDF

Designed like a well-loved passport
A warm, vintage-air-travel look — parchment tones, airmail navy, postage-stamp motifs — with a full dark mode for night flights.

Passport Stamps runs everywhere your family does — iPhone, iPad, and Mac — so the map stays in sync no matter whose device someone opens it on.

results.description:
Where have you been? Spin a 3D globe, tap the countries you've visited and watch them fill with color. StampStory turns them into a passport page you can post to your Story.

Add your whole travel history in one sitting. No dates, no forms, no trip logs. After that it's one tap per new country.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap a country on the globe, or tick it off a checklist with search
• Neighbors never share a color
• Zoom in to see country names. Tiny countries like Singapore, Vatican City and Monaco are marked so you can tap them too
• 232 countries and territories count toward your share of the world

YOUR PASSPORT
• The percent of the world you've seen and a bar for each of six continents
• A traveler rank that grows with your count: Newcomer, Wanderer at 5, Explorer at 10, Globetrotter at 25, World Traveler at 50, Global Nomad at 75, Century Traveler at 100
• A stamp for each milestone

SHARE IT
Your countries become a passport page with your name, a passport photo, a stamp for every continent and a flag sticker for every country. Post it straight to an Instagram or Facebook Story, save it to Photos, or send it from the share sheet. The link to get the app rides along, ready for a link sticker.

Every milestone gets its own Story card, offered right when it happens: a boarding pass for a new country, a travel poster for a new continent, a club card for a new rank and a world stamp for 10%, 25%, 50% of the world and beyond.

WELCOMES
Land in a country that isn't on your map yet and a notification says "Welcome to Japan. Tap to stamp it on your map." One tap stamps it and opens its card. Optional and free. It uses your iPhone's location, on the phone only.

MORE
• A "you are here" bubble and a button that flies there (optional, needs location)
• Fourteen themes that change the sky, the globe, the screens and the cards
• Works offline. Only buying Gold needs a connection

FREE, FOREVER
The globe, every country, the passport, ranks and stamps, every milestone card in its standard style, sharing, welcomes, the Sky and Night Lights themes and one passport photo.

STAMPSTORY GOLD
• Every theme: Gold Foil, Pink Foil, Earth, Lapis, Antique, Atlas, Sunset, Rosé, Chalkboard, Blueprint, Terminal and Ink
• All twelve passport photos
• A golden passport page on every card you share
• Gold card styles: the Suitcase for the passport, and a Postcard, a World puzzle, a Medal, a Passport cover and Around the world for milestones
Take it by the year, by the month, or once for life.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no server. Your countries stay on your iPhone, and a shared image goes only where you send it. The app counts how it's used under a random install id, never which countries, how many or your name. No ads, no tracking across apps, nothing sold.

PURCHASE TERMS
Yearly and monthly Gold are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, and the subscription renews at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings. Lifetime Gold is a one-time purchase. There is no free trial.

Questions or a country that looks wrong? stampstory-support@shoopi.dev

results.description:
Daily Postcard is a pen pal app for exchanging postcards with people around the world.
Write a short line, add a photo, and Postbird will carry your postcard across the sea to someone, somewhere.

■ Pen pals, one postcard at a time
- Postbird delivers your postcards to people all over the world.
- If you click with someone while exchanging postcards, you can become stamp friends.
- With stamp friends, you can add a short voice or video message to the back of your postcard (with a VIP level or a subscription).
- Use keywords of interest to find people who share your tastes.

■ Different languages? No problem
- Read postcards written in other languages with the built-in translation feature.
- The app is available in 15 languages:
  Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Indonesian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Turkish, Italian, Thai, Arabic

■ The island where Postbird lives
- On the home island, the sky turns from day to sunset to night, and rain falls now and then.
- On clear nights, fireflies and shooting stars appear, and dolphins and whales sometimes show up out at sea.
- The moon waxes and wanes with the real calendar.
- On your birthday, the island dresses up in birthday decorations.
- You can turn off weather effects in Settings, or switch on Lite mode for a lighter experience.

■ Country stamps in your passport
- Exchange postcards with friends from another country, and that country's stamp goes into your passport.
- Collect entry, visa, and residency stamps to level up and unlock postage stamps for decorating your profile.

■ Make it yours
- Decorate the front of your postcard with a photo or pattern, and choose a design for the card back.
- Show your style with stamps, stamp frames, and hats for Postbird.
- Introduce yourself with a voice recording on your profile.

■ Stories beyond postcards
- Share your days on Feed and Talk, and ask what others think with Vote.
- In Echo, leave a short line on the sand and share empathy with others.
- During Pearl Island season events, collect pearls and trade them for seasonal items. Mini-game events may open as well.

■ Comfortable and safe
- Choose the countries, genders, ages, and languages you'd rather not receive postcards from.
- Block or report anyone who makes you uncomfortable.
- Set Do Not Disturb hours to keep notifications quiet at night.
- Keep special postcards in your Drawer, and save photos you like to your device.

■ Good to know
- New postcards left unread for a long time expire automatically.
- Some decoration items and extra features are available through in-app purchases or a subscription.
- The timing and content of season events may change.

Stamped là bản đồ du lịch và nhật ký tem dùng để theo dõi những nơi bạn đã đến.

Thu thập tem quốc gia, thêm các chuyến thăm kèm ngày tháng, và xem lịch sử du lịch của bạn phát triển thành một hộ chiếu trực quan. Stamped được xây dựng cho những du khách muốn cảm giác thỏa mãn khi đếm quốc gia, sự rõ ràng của bản đồ thế giới, và niềm vui khi sưu tầm tem.

XÂY DỰNG HỘ CHIẾU DU LỊCH CỦA BẠN

- Thu thập tem cho các quốc gia và lãnh thổ
- Xây dựng bộ sưu tập trực quan về mọi nơi bạn đã đến
- Xem tổng số quốc gia và mức độ bao phủ thế giới trong nháy mắt
- Mở từng địa điểm để xem tem, vị trí trên bản đồ và chi tiết chuyến đi

ĐÁNH DẤU NƠI BẠN ĐÃ ĐẾN TRÊN BẢN ĐỒ

- Xem các quốc gia đã thăm được đánh dấu trên bản đồ thế giới tương tác
- Chạm vào bản đồ để mở quốc gia và thu thập tem
- Chuyển thẳng từ tem quốc gia đến vị trí trên bản đồ
- Khám phá với phong cách bản đồ gọn gàng, tập trung vào hành trình của bạn

GHI NHỚ MỖI CHUYẾN ĐI

- Thêm các chuyến thăm có tên cho từng quốc gia
- Lưu ngày bắt đầu và kết thúc cho chuyến cuối tuần, chuyến dài ngày và chuyến quay lại
- Giữ nhiều chuyến thăm trong cùng một quốc gia
- Chỉnh sửa hoặc xóa chuyến thăm khi lịch sử du lịch thay đổi

TÌM KIẾM THẾ GIỚI

- Tìm kiếm theo tên quốc gia, khu vực, tiểu vùng hoặc mã quốc gia
- Duyệt các quốc gia với cờ và thông tin khu vực
- Xem thông tin hữu ích như thủ đô, diện tích, ngôn ngữ và tiền tệ

CHỌN CÁCH BẠN ĐẾM ĐỊA ĐIỂM

Mỗi du khách đếm thế giới theo cách hơi khác nhau. Stamped cho phép bạn chọn danh sách địa điểm phù hợp:

- Thành viên Liên Hợp Quốc
- Thành viên và quan sát viên Liên Hợp Quốc
- Quốc gia và lãnh thổ

Bản đồ và thống kê cập nhật theo cách bạn chọn đếm.

QUẢN LÝ DỮ LIỆU LINH HOẠT

- Xuất tem và chuyến thăm dưới dạng tệp sao lưu
- Nhập lại dữ liệu bất cứ khi nào cần khôi phục
- Sử dụng Stamped mà không cần theo dõi GPS nền
- Bắt đầu sưu tầm ngay lập tức mà không cần tạo hồ sơ phức tạp

TẠI SAO CHỌN STAMPED?

Nhiều ứng dụng du lịch được xây dựng xoay quanh kế hoạch phức tạp, bảng tin xã hội, quảng cáo hoặc nhật ký tuyến đường tự động. Stamped tập trung vào niềm vui đơn giản khi trả lời một câu hỏi: tôi đã đến đâu?

Dù bạn đang đếm quốc gia, nhớ lại một hành trình một lần trong đời, hay ghi chép những chuyến cuối tuần nhanh chóng, Stamped mang đến cho bạn một không gian yên tĩnh, trực quan để lưu giữ lịch sử du lịch.

results.description:
Your camera roll already knows everywhere you've been. Been turns it into something you can hold: a collection of travel cards, one for every city and landmark you've stood in.
No typing. No check-ins. Been reads where and when your photos were taken, right on your phone, and builds your collection in under a minute. Nothing leaves your device.

EVERY CARD IS EARNED 
The only way to get a card is to be there. Cards come in Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary, set by the place itself. Every card is individually numbered and yours alone, with real foil that moves in the light.

YOUR PASSPORT
Your collection fills a passport of its own: country stamps, first-entry years, and a document number nobody else has. The globe shows the shape of your travels so far. The empty half is the invitation.

NEW PLACES, NEW CARDS 
Visit somewhere new, open Been, and the card is already there. The reveal is the moment the place becomes yours to keep.

YOUR MEMORIES, ON THE BACK 
Every card carries your own photos from that place on its back. Browse them as a grid, or let them play back to you. Your collection is a record of where you've been and the memories you made there. Not a scoreboard. Not a feed.

SHARE IT, IF YOU WANT
Publish your passport or any single card as its own page at been.fm. You choose what to share, card by card, photo by photo. Unpublish anytime.

HOLD IT IN YOUR HANDS*
Your collection, printed as a real deck of cards. Pick the cards, pick the style, and wait for the doorbell. The places you've been, in your hands.
*Available in eligible countries. Requires an active Premium membership.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos are scanned on your device and never uploaded. No ads inside the app. Your travel history is never sold or shared.

Start with ten cards free. Premium unlocks your entire collection, new arrivals as they happen, publishing, and printed decks.

Thử câu đố về mã sân bay, tên sân bay, cửa thoát hiểm máy bay và bảng chữ cái phiên âm NATO. Câu đố có 26 bản ghi âm riêng và hoạt động ngoại tuyến. Bạn cũng có thể xem tài liệu về 42 loại máy bay có dẫn nguồn và tùy chọn xem thời tiết hiện tại.

THỐNG KÊ CHUYẾN ĐI
Theo dõi số sân bay và lượt ghé thăm. Lifetime Access bổ sung quốc gia, châu lục, cột mốc và sân bay thường ghé nhất. Tạo thẻ để chia sẻ bộ sưu tập và kỷ niệm.

RIÊNG TƯ, KHÔNG CẦN TÀI KHOẢN
Dấu đã xác nhận và ngày ghé thăm được lưu trên thiết bị. Lịch sử vị trí thô không được tải lên. Các tính năng cốt lõi của bộ sưu tập hoạt động ngoại tuyến; hình ảnh bản đồ và thời tiết có thể cần internet. Bạn có thể xóa từng mục riêng lẻ.

BẮT ĐẦU MIỄN PHÍ
Năm sân bay đầu tiên, câu đố, thẻ bộ sưu tập và giao diện hãng hàng không lịch sử đều miễn phí. Chia sẻ một vé SkyStamp để mở thêm 5 chỗ lưu sân bay. Mua Lifetime Access một lần để có dấu không giới hạn, giao diện bổ sung, thẻ cao cấp, thống kê nâng cao, nhập văn bản tuyến đường hoặc CSV và xuất CSV.

SkyStamp ghi lại các sân bay đã ghé, không theo dõi chuyến bay trực tiếp hay cảnh báo chậm chuyến. Câu đố và tài liệu dành cho học hỏi thông thường, không thay thế đào tạo hoặc phục vụ khai thác bay. Giao diện không thể hiện liên kết hay sự bảo trợ của hãng hàng không.

results.description:
パスポートは、大切な旅の記録なのに、気軽には持ち歩けない。
そんな想いから生まれたのが「SEKA PASS（セカパス）」です。

パスポートには、これまで訪れた国の記憶が詰まっています。でも実物は貴重品だから、気軽に見返したり、誰かに見せたりすることはできません。「あの国、いつ行ったっけ？」「どこの都市だったかな」と思い出そうとしても、記録が残っていないことがほとんどです。

SEKA PASSは、そんな旅の記録を、いつでもスマホの中で見返せるようにしたアプリです。

■ パスポート風スタンプ帳
訪問国・居住国・経由国を、国ごとのビザスタンプ風デザインで記録。入国日・出国日・移動手段もまとめて残せます。

■ 世界地図で訪問国を可視化
自分が訪れた国を世界地図上でひと目で確認。大陸別の達成率や、世界制覇率もリアルタイムで表示されます。

■ パスポートのスキャンで自動入力
お手持ちのパスポートを撮影するだけで、氏名・旅券番号・有効期限などをかんたん自動入力。

■ 旅のハイライト
初めての旅、最新の旅、最長の旅、最多だった年など、あなたの旅の記録を自動で振り返り。

■ 友達と訪問国数を競い合う
QRコードで友達を追加し、訪問国数ランキングで競い合ったり、好きな国やひとことコメントをシェアしたり。友達の新しい訪問記録はリアルタイムでお知らせします。

■ 有効期限・思い出のプッシュ通知
パスポートの有効期限が近づくと事前にお知らせ。「◯年前の今日、この国にいた」という旅の記念日も通知でお届けします。

■ ビザ・渡航情報もチェック
気になる国の首都・言語・通貨・気候・日本からの飛行時間・ビザ情報などをまとめて確認できます。

■ プライバシー第一設計
パスポート情報は端末内にのみ保存。訪問記録は友達機能を使わない限り、外部に送信されることはありません。

旅の記録は、次の旅への一歩でもあります。
まずはこれまで訪れた国を、SEKA PASSに記録してみませんか?

A map of everywhere you've been, and a passport page of stamps to prove it.

No account. No sign-in. Wander never uploads your photos, and your map syncs only to your own iCloud unless you share it. One optional payment — never a subscription.

Wander is a travel tracker for people who like beautiful things. Tap a country and it fills in. Add the date and a stamp lands on your passport page, drawn the way that country's real entry stamp looks. Zoom in and countries break into states and regions. Cities come from the photos you already have, or from search.

YOU ALMOST MET
Add a friend and Wander finds every country you share — and whether the two of you were ever in the same country in the same month without knowing it. It reads dates you already have, it works by handle and QR code with no account, and everything you share goes only to friends who've added you back, encrypted so that neither we nor Apple can read it.

THE MAP
Every country on one poster-grade world map. Mark where you've been, where you've lived, and where you only passed through. Your progress, your continents and your latest stamps fold up underneath it.

THE PASSPORT
A dated stamp for every country. Share your passport page, your map or your ledger as a card made for the feed — no watermark.

THE LEDGER
Countries, regions, cities, days abroad, and progress by continent. Choose the counting rule you agree with, from UN members to the widest list of territories.

IMPORT YOUR PHOTOS
Wander reads where and when each photo was taken, on your phone, and stamps the countries and dates for you. It never looks at what's in them, and never copies or uploads them. Open a stamp to see your own photos from there — only you see them.

FREE, FOREVER
The world map, photo import, iCloud sync, friends, almost-met, sharing and full data export are free and stay free. One optional purchase unlocks regions and states (3,607 of them), 34,078 cities, and alternative counting systems. No subscription. No ads. No account.

Your data is yours. Export everything as CSV or JSON, any time.

Park'd is the digital national park passport for road trippers, retirees, families, and serious park completionists working through the full list of US national parks, monuments, and historic sites. • Articles and guides — history, geology, flora and fauna, conservation efforts

Why park collectors use Park'd:

• Tracking the "all 63" challenge — visit every US national park
• Working through specific regions: Utah's Mighty 5, California's parks, Alaska's wilderness parks
• Family road trip planning across multiple parks
• RV and vanlife park-hopping with completion tracking
• Junior Ranger families completing programs together
• Retirees crossing parks off a bucket list
• Hikers and photographers who want to remember every visit

All 63 national parks tracked, plus monuments and historic sites:
Acadia, Arches, Badlands, Big Bend, Biscayne, Black Canyon of the Gunnison, Bryce Canyon, Canyonlands, Capitol Reef, Carlsbad Caverns, Channel Islands, Congaree, Crater Lake, Cuyahoga Valley, Death Valley, Denali, Dry Tortugas, Everglades, Gates of the Arctic, Gateway Arch, Glacier, Glacier Bay, Grand Canyon, Grand Teton, Great Basin, Great Sand Dunes, Great Smoky Mountains, Guadalupe Mountains, Haleakalā, Hawai'i Volcanoes, Hot Springs, Indiana Dunes, Isle Royale, Joshua Tree, Katmai, Kenai Fjords, Kings Canyon, Kobuk Valley, Lake Clark, Lassen Volcanic, Mammoth Cave, Mesa Verde, Mount Rainier, New River Gorge, North Cascades, Olympic, Petrified Forest, Pinnacles, Redwood, Rocky Mountain, Saguaro, Sequoia, Shenandoah, Theodore Roosevelt, Virgin Islands, Voyageurs, White Sands, Wind Cave, Wrangell-St. Elias, Yellowstone, Yosemite, Zion — plus monuments, recreation areas, and historic sites.

results.description:
訪れた空港を、1冊のパスポートに。

Airport Passportは、世界の空港を訪れた記録を、スタンプ・写真・訪問回数で積み重ねる旅行記録アプリです。
世界4,008空港を9つの旅地域から探し、同じ空港への再訪も日付ごとに残せます。

■ 空港で、旅のスタンプを
現在地から近くの空港を判定し、空港コード・日付・訪問回数が入ったスタンプを押せます。

■ 過去の旅行写真から記録を作る
写真の撮影日時と位置情報を端末上で確認し、過去に訪れた空港の候補を提案します。位置情報がない写真や候補に出ない旅は手動でも登録できます。

■ 再訪するたび、思い出が増えていく
同じ空港を再訪した場合も、訪問ごとに新しいスタンプと写真を追加できます。空港詳細のタイムラインで、旅の積み重なりを振り返れます。

■ 世界の空港を地図と索引で探す
世界4,008空港を9つの旅地域に整理。正式名、空港コード、日本語名、都市名、羽田・セントレアなどの別名から検索できます。地図は訪問済みの空港だけに絞り込めます。

■ 自分だけのスタンプコレクション
訪問済みの空港だけを最近の訪問順で一覧にし、地域・国・国内地域ごとのスタンプ帳も開けます。空港ごとに写真とスタンプを選び、自分だけのページを作れます。

■ 旅を作品にしてシェア
・VISIT STORY：1回の訪問を写真で振り返る動画
・AIRPORT MEMORY：同じ空港への再訪履歴をまとめる画像・動画
・JOURNEY MAP：訪れた空港を地図・写真・スタンプで時系列にたどる動画
・AIRPORT PASSPORT SHARE：訪れた空港全体を1冊のパスポートとして共有
・STAMP MOMENT：チェックイン直後のスタンプを保存・共有

■ 無料版とPro
新規ユーザーは、9つの旅地域から1地域を選び、その地域の空港を無料で記録できます。既存ユーザーには東アジアが無料地域として設定されます。無料地域以外の空港も閲覧・検索でき、これまでに登録した訪問や写真は引き続き閲覧・編集できます。

共有機能は無料で、使う写真や訪問、動画の表示時間を選べます。買い切りのProでは、世界9地域すべてで新しい訪問を記録でき、広告も表示されません。価格と販売条件はApp Storeの表示をご確認ください。

■ データについて
写真の撮影日時・位置情報と現在地は、訪問候補の提案や空港チェックインのために端末上で利用します。写真そのものや正確な位置情報を運営者のサーバーへ送信・保存することはありません。iCloudを有効にしている場合、訪問記録とパスポート情報はAppleのCloudKitを通じて同期されることがあります。

空港へ行く日も、過去の旅を見返す日も。
Airport Passportに、あなたの旅を残してください。

가까운 궁궐과 사찰에 가서 스탬프를 찍고, 전국 1,300곳 문화유산을 나만의 여권에 모으세요.

앱을 열면 지금 있는 곳에서 가까운 유산이 남은 거리와 함께 보입니다. 가까이 가서 방문을 확인하면 도감에 스탬프가 찍히고, 스탬프는 고조선부터 근현대까지 각자의 시대에 자리 잡습니다.

이런 걸 할 수 있어요
내 근처 유산 다섯 곳을 거리와 함께 바로 보기, 스탬프를 찍을 수 있는 곳은 빛나요
국보, 사적, 명승, 천연기념물 1,300여 곳을 지역별로, 목록이나 지도로 찾아보기
궁궐, 산성, 고분군, 서원처럼 실제로 찾아가는 사적 517곳 포함
유산마다 해설, 시대, 주소, 사진을 원하는 언어로 읽기
GPS로 방문을 확인하고 일러스트 스탬프 받기
다녀온 곳을 지도 한 장에 도장으로 찍은 나의 스탬프 여권 만들고 공유하기
시대별 수집 현황을 보며 여덟 단계 탐험가 등급 올리기
가고 싶은 곳을 저장하고 동선 계획하기

일곱 개 언어
한국어, 영어, 일본어, 중국어 간체, 중국어 번체, 스페인어, 프랑스어를 지원합니다. 화면 문구뿐 아니라 모든 유산의 이름과 해설, 주소까지 번역됩니다. 한국 밖에서 앱을 열면 서울의 대표 유산부터 보여 줍니다.

개인정보
계정도 회원가입도 없습니다. 방문 기록, 저장한 장소, 프로필은 기기 안에만 저장되고 서버로 보내지 않습니다. 위치는 가까운 유산을 찾고 현장에서 방문을 확인하는 데에만 기기 안에서 사용합니다.

문화유산 정보는 국가유산청 국가유산포털의 공공데이터를 이용합니다.

Atlas is the travel tracker for people who don't just visit places — they collect them. Mark every country, city, and state you've been to on a stunning interactive world map. Attach photos, journal entries, and memories to each destination. Build your personal atlas of the world.

WHY TRAVELERS CHOOSE ATLAS

Most travel trackers just count countries. Atlas goes deeper. Each destination becomes a living memory — photos from your camera roll, dated journal entries, notes about the hidden gems you'd never want to forget. It's the difference between a number and a story.

Track where you've been. Plan where you're going next. Share your map with the people who matter. Atlas is the only travel companion you need — from your first passport stamp to your hundredth country.

FEATURES

INTERACTIVE WORLD MAP
Tap any country to mark it visited. Drill down to cities and states for deeper detail. Watch your personal atlas fill with color as you travel more.

TRACK COUNTRIES, CITIES & STATES
Go beyond country counting. Mark the exact cities you explored and the states you crossed. See your travels at every zoom level.

PHOTO MEMORIES
Attach your favorite photos to each destination. Flip through your travels like a beautifully organized scrapbook that grows with every trip.

TRIP JOURNAL
Write dated entries for every destination. Capture the small moments — that sunrise in Santorini, the taxi driver in Tokyo, the meal you still think about.

BUCKET LIST
Track where you've been AND where you want to go. Plan your next adventure with a visual wishlist that lives on the same beautiful map.

TRAVEL STATS
Countries visited. Cities explored. Percentage of the world seen. Continental breakdowns. Watch your numbers grow, year by year.

SHARE YOUR MAP
Share your travel map with friends on Instagram, Messages, or anywhere. Compare journeys. Inspire each other. Plan trips together.

WHO ATLAS IS FOR

- Travelers tracking lifetime trips, from 5 countries to 150
- Digital nomads logging every new city
- Backpackers documenting every adventure
- Families preserving travel memories across years
- Anyone who's ever wondered "wait, when WAS I in Prague?"

SUPPORT ATLAS PRO

results.description:
WanderStamp is a digital passport that proves you were there.

Visit real-world locations, tap an NFC card, and collect a cryptographically verified stamp, backed by blockchain technology and hardware authentication. No one can fake it. No one can take it away.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Visit a location with a WanderStamp checkpoint
2. Hold your phone near the NFC card
3. Your presence is verified by hardware cryptography and GPS
4. A unique stamp NFT is minted on the Bitcoin Cash blockchain
5. The stamp appears in your digital passport - yours forever

YOUR PASSPORT, YOUR STAMPS
Every stamp is an NFT that you truly own. Your wallet, your keys, your collection. Trade them, share them, or keep them as proof of the places you've been.

Each stamp features:
• Unique hand-stamped ink effect with rotating colors
• Location name, country, and date
• Cryptographic proof of presence (NFC + GPS)
• Permanent on-chain record on Bitcoin Cash
• BCMR metadata viewable in any compatible wallet

BEAUTIFUL PASSPORT EXPERIENCE
• Passport-style cover with gold embossed branding
• Guilloche watermark backgrounds on every page
• Stamps placed like a real customs officer stamped them
• ID page with your passport number and travel stats
• Journey tab showing countries visited

FOR BUSINESSES
Gift shops, landmarks, museums, and attractions can sell WanderStamp checkpoints to offer visitors a unique digital collectible. Visit https://wanderstamp.io/partners to learn more.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your wallet seed phrase never leaves your device. Your location is only captured when you tap a checkpoint - we never track you. Your stamps are self-custodial NFTs that we cannot access or revoke.

Built with Bitcoin Cash CashTokens. Verified by EchoV EM4425 NFC hardware cryptography.

results.description:
Stamp Stat turns the places you have been into a collection worth showing. Every country, capital, and city you visit earns a Stamp with original artwork. Stamps add up to Goals, and both add up to your Travel Score. Nothing here is checked off a list: every Stamp is backed by a visit in your History, and a visit logged on the spot is marked Verified.

446 STAMPS TO COLLECT
• 232 countries and territories
• 207 cities and capitals
• 7 continents
Collected Stamps show in full color. Locked Stamps show as silhouettes, so you always know what is left.

36 GOALS
Goals combine Stamps into milestones: 5 Countries, 25 Capitals, All Continents, Nordic Five, Baltic States, Europe 44, World Megacities, and more. Set one as your current Goal and watch it fill.

TRAVEL SCORE
Every collected Stamp and every completed Goal is worth fixed points. Your Travel Score is the total. Share it as a travel card straight from the app.

VERIFIED ON THE SPOT
While you are there, tap Verify current location. Stamp Stat takes one location reading, names the place, and marks the visit Verified. It never tracks you in the background.
Past trips count too. Add a past visit with the place and the date, and it is marked Manual. Stamps, Goals, and Travel Score are all calculated from your History, so no Stamp exists without a visit behind it.

YOUR DATA
• Confirmed visits are backed up with your Stamp Stat account and restored on any iPhone you sign in to.
• Export your travel data as JSON or delete it permanently, any time, in Me > Data and privacy.
• Location is used only when you verify a visit. Place names come from Amazon Location Service through Stamp Stat's own server. Amazon never receives your account identity or your History.
• No ads, no tracking SDKs, no social feed.

FREE, THEN UNLIMITED
The download is free and so are your first 10 Stamps. Stamps you earn after that stay sealed until you unlock Stamp Stat Unlimited, as a one-time Lifetime purchase or a Yearly subscription. Recording visits, export, and deletion never require a purchase. Prices appear in the app in your local currency before you buy.

Stamp Stat Unlimited (Yearly) is an auto-renewing subscription. Apple charges your Apple Account when you subscribe and at each yearly renewal until you cancel. Cancel any time in your Apple Account subscription settings; Unlimited stays active until the end of the paid period.

Kiểm soát việc tuân thủ quy định du lịch của bạn với Borderlog.

Được thiết kế cho dân du mục số, người thường xuyên đi công tác và cộng đồng expat, Borderlog là công cụ chuyên nghiệp giúp bạn không còn phải đoán mò về quy định visa và cư trú thuế. Được xây dựng chú trọng độ chính xác và quyền riêng tư, ứng dụng giúp bạn luôn hợp pháp khi qua biên giới mà không phải căng thẳng tính toán thủ công.

Tính năng chính:

- Máy tính Schengen 90/180 thông minh: Tự động theo dõi thời gian lưu trú của bạn trong khu vực Schengen với cửa sổ trượt 180 ngày chính xác.
- Theo dõi cư trú thuế: Luôn nắm rõ quy tắc 183 ngày. Theo dõi thời gian ở mỗi quốc gia để quản lý nghĩa vụ thuế hiệu quả.
- Tự động phát hiện qua biên giới: Ghi lại hành trình của bạn một cách dễ dàng. Borderlog phát hiện khi bạn qua biên giới và cập nhật lịch sử theo thời gian thực.
- Báo cáo PDF: Tạo báo cáo lịch sử du lịch chi tiết cho hồ sơ xin visa, bảo hiểm hoặc hồ sơ thuế chỉ trong vài giây.
- Bản đồ và thống kê du lịch tương tác: Hình dung hành trình của bạn. Xem bạn đã khám phá bao nhiêu phần của thế giới với bản đồ đẹp mắt và số liệu thống kê hữu ích.
- Quyền riêng tư là trên hết: Dữ liệu của bạn thuộc về bạn. Toàn bộ lịch sử du lịch được lưu trữ riêng tư trong tài khoản iCloud của bạn và không bao giờ chia sẻ với bên thứ ba.

Emblem turns the places you visit into digital souvenirs you keep.

Each Emblem is an artwork made for a real place, often by a local artist. Go there, open the map and collect it: it joins your Passport, with the date, the place and a photo of the moment.

COLLECT AT REAL PLACES
• The map shows the Emblems around you, in cities, museums, landmarks, festivals and events.

• Some Emblems come alive: watch them move, view them in AR, or try on Santa's Cap, a filter for your face.

FILL YOUR PASSPORTS

DISCOVER A COUNTRY'S CULTURE

SHARE AND CELEBRATE

THE PORTAL

Emblem is free to download and available in 22 languages. Collect the world, one place at a time.

results.description:
Dots biến thư viện ảnh của bạn thành bản đồ du lịch. Ứng dụng tô màu mọi quốc gia bạn từng đến, ghim các thành phố và sắp xếp chuyến đi trên dòng thời gian, dựa vào địa điểm và ngày tháng có sẵn trong ảnh.

BẢN ĐỒ DU LỊCH
• Mọi quốc gia đã đến trên một bản đồ thế giới, kèm số lượng trên tổng 195 quốc gia
• Phóng to một quốc gia để xem từng thành phố và điểm dừng
• Nhiều kiểu bản đồ

TEM HỘ CHIẾU
Mỗi quốc gia có một con tem riêng với màu mực, hình dạng và ngày nhập cảnh riêng. Chia sẻ hộ chiếu dưới dạng ảnh cỡ story.

CHUYẾN ĐI TRÊN DÒNG THỜI GIAN
• Các chuyến đi tìm thấy trong ảnh, theo từng thành phố, kèm số ngày lưu trú
• Tự thêm chuyến đi hoặc lên kế hoạch cho chuyến tiếp theo
• Lộ trình từng ngày được vẽ từ những nơi bạn chụp ảnh

TỔNG KẾT HÀNH TRÌNH
Sau lần quét đầu tiên, Dots chiếu bản tổng kết ngắn: các quốc gia và thành phố, năm bạn đi nhiều nhất và thành phố bạn hay quay lại.

THÔNG TIN VỀ MỌI THÀNH PHỐ
Thời tiết và giờ địa phương, chất lượng không khí, khí hậu theo tháng, tỷ giá, ngôn ngữ và loại ổ cắm.

BÁO QUỐC GIA MỚI
Tùy chọn. Nhận thông báo khi bạn đến một quốc gia chưa có trong hộ chiếu. Dùng vị trí nền.

RIÊNG TƯ TỪ THIẾT KẾ
Vị trí ảnh được đọc ngay trên thiết bị của bạn. Ảnh không bao giờ được tải lên. Dùng Dots không cần tài khoản hoặc đăng nhập bằng Apple để lưu chuyến đi.

Có câu hỏi hay ý tưởng? Hãy viết cho chúng tôi trong Cài đặt.

results.description:
LOQAH is a free philately passport for travel.

Philately is stamp collecting. In LOQAH the stamps are for places. Every fort, monument, stepwell, ghat, beach, summit and garden has its own carefully crafted stamp. Visit the place, collect its stamp, and keep it in one passport that grows with every trip.

HOW IT WORKS
- Open the app at a place and collect its stamp.
- LOQAH checks where you are once, at that moment. If you are there, the stamp is confirmed.
- Every stamp goes into your passport with its date. A small celebration marks every tenth stamp.

A COLLECTION THAT IS YOURS
- Add trips from before the app as past trips, placed by the date you remember.
- Declare your visit and a past trip becomes self-confirmed, in silver.
- Add a short note and a ten second private voice note to any stamp.
- On a stamp collected on site, turn it over to see the sky at that moment.
- Stamps of merit mark milestones, and each shows how it was earned.

SHARE IT
- Send a friend your invitation link and swap passports.
- See where your paths crossed.
- Turn any stamp into a card with your photo and share it. Keep any stamp to yourself if you prefer.

PLACES TO COLLECT
More than two thousand places so far: forts, monuments, stepwells, ghats, beaches, national parks and more, with more added all the time.

FREE, WITH NO PASSWORDS
Sign in with Apple, with Google, or with a six digit code sent to your email.

LOQAH is a fun keepsake made by a private company, and has nothing to do with any government or authority. Every stamp is created by LOQAH. It is not a travel document and cannot be used to cross a border.

Also searched as Loka, Lokah, Lokha, Loqa and Loqha. The name is spelled LOQAH.

Website: https://loqah.com

results.description:
사진첩에 묻혀 있던 여행이 지구 위에 켜집니다.

온빛은 사진 속 장소를 읽어 가본 도시에 불을 켜고, 도시마다 우표 한 장을 발행하는 여행 기록 앱입니다. 적을 것이 없습니다. 사진이 이미 다 알고 있으니까요.

가본 곳에 불이 켜집니다

사진의 촬영 위치로 지구가 밝아집니다. 처음 켠 날부터 쭉, 가본 만큼 환해집니다.
아직 안 간 곳도 보입니다. 다음 여행은 거기서 시작됩니다.

도시마다 우표 한 장

다녀온 도시마다 우표가 발행됩니다. 뒷면은 그 도시에서 찍은 내 사진 한 장.
여권이 채워질수록 내 여행의 모양이 보입니다.

다음 여행은 탑승권 한 장에

새 여행을 만들면 탑승권이 발권됩니다. 날짜 · 함께 가는 사람 · D-day가 한눈에.
예약 확인 캡처 한 장이면 도시 · 날짜 · 편 · 요금까지 읽어 여행이 만들어집니다.

친구와 같이 짭니다

초대장 한 장이면 일정 · 챙길 것 · 쓴 돈을 함께 적습니다.
챙길 것은 각자, 어댑터는 한 명이. 누가 챙겼는지 얼굴로 보입니다.
누가 얼마 냈는지 끝까지. 정산이 한 번에 끝납니다.

돌아오면 엔딩 크레딧

여행이 끝나면 영화의 엔딩 크레딧처럼 영상이 나옵니다. 함께한 사람, 간 곳, 쓴 돈, 그리고 사진.
사진첩에 저장해서 그대로 올리세요. 여행 어땠냐고 물으면, 이걸 보여 주세요.

오늘 할 일은 딱 하나

매일 오늘의 도시와 작은 퀘스트 하나. 지난 여행의 한 장이 엽서처럼 도착합니다.

온빛이 지키는 것

사진은 폰 밖으로 나가지 않습니다. 지구 · 우표 · 영상은 전부 폰 안에서 만들어집니다.
예약 캡처는 읽은 뒤 바로 버립니다. 저장하지 않습니다.
계정 없이도 쓸 수 있습니다. 친구와 같이 짤 때만 로그인합니다.

results.description:
A travel bucket list that feels like a passport.

Videnda is a private travel atlas and journal, built for discovering places, planning trips, and keeping a record of where you have been. More than 20,000 remarkable places across 190 countries are included in the app, from museums and beaches to local dishes, viewpoints, and natural wonders. Everything works offline.

PLAN IT, THEN STAMP IT

Save places from the catalogue or add your own. When you visit, stamp the page with the date, a note, and a photo, creating a personal record of the journey.

A CATALOGUE, NOT A FEED

Each place has its own carefully prepared entry, with a short explanation of why it is worth visiting, illustrated details, city guides, UNESCO information, and themed collections ranging from essential landmarks to food markets.

YOUR PASSPORT

Watch your travels take shape through stamps, countries, continents, and wonders. A brass world map fills in as you explore, turning your travel history into something worth keeping.

FIND SOMETHING NEARBY

Looking for somewhere to eat or visit? Videnda can show you the closest places in the catalogue using your last known location. Because the search happens on your device, it still works in airplane mode.

KEEP IT, PRINT IT, SHARE IT

Turn your trips into story-style albums, print your journal as a book, or back everything up in a single file that you control. A home-screen widget keeps your latest stamp close at hand.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account. No ads. No analytics. No tracking.

Videnda does not rely on external servers. Your journal, notes, and photos stay on your device unless you choose to export or share them.

One purchase. Everything included.

results.description:
Roamly turns the world into a game you play a few minutes a day.

Every morning you get one main mission about a country you care about — the one you live in, the one you're flying to, or the one you're standing in right now. Finish it and your streak survives the day. Four bonus missions land beside it and refresh every six hours, so the board is never empty.

WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO
• One main mission a day, picked for where you are and where you're going next
• Four bonus missions, refreshed every 6 hours — sixteen a day
• Missions to learn, notice, photograph and explore. Never anything unsafe, costly or embarrassing
• Answer in your own words, tap to confirm, or take the photo it asks for

AN AI THAT KNOWS YOUR TRIP
• Ask anything about your destination and get an answer that already knows your dates
• Build a day-by-day itinerary in seconds, and keep it
• Written mission answers are read and graded — it tells you what you actually got

PASSPORT STAMPS THAT ARE REAL
• Cross a border and Roamly notices. Finish that first day's missions and the stamp is yours
• Your passport fills with countries you genuinely stood in, not ones you tapped
• Mission photos are filed by country and town in your own travel gallery

A STREAK WORTH KEEPING
• The day ends at midnight where YOU are, not back home — a flight east costs you nothing
• Miss a day and a freeze token covers it. Earn them by clearing the bonus board
• XP, ten levels, and a celebration for every stamp, level and milestone

FRIENDS, LIGHTLY
• Add friends, watch the leaderboard, compare streaks and stamps
• No feed, no comments, no noise

THE PLANNING HALF
• Line up your next destinations with real dates and Roamly plans the board around them
• Every country arrives with its own landscape photography — 1,957 photographs of 243 countries, always in the right season
• When a trip ends, Roamly plays it back: the days you did something, the photos you took, the countries you added

Roamly is free. There is nothing to unlock, nothing to subscribe to, and no advertising.

results.releaseNotes:
THE PASSPORT — your travels, stamped.

Every border you cross now presses a stamp into your own passport — real customs-style dies, arrival and departure inks, filled page by page like the genuine article. Flip through it with a proper page curl, right through to the back cover.

Your data page — add your name and photo, and the book becomes officially yours (the photo never leaves your device)
Share it as a film — your whole passport flipping itself, ready for Stories
Proof of Wander — your entire collection on one share card: every stamp, every flag, your stats pressed like an officer's seal
Covers & linings (Pro) — Midnight, Forest, Lagoon, Onyx and Maroon, each re-inking the pages inside
Feel the stamp — a thump in your hand every time a new country lands

Globelog is the travel record that never asks who you are.

There is no account, no sign-in and no server. Nothing to be logged out of, and nothing to lose.

THE MAP IS THE APP

Open it and the world is already there. Tap a country to stamp it. Tap a US state to stamp that. No email, no password, no "create a free account to save your map" — the map is yours from the first second, and it is drawn on your phone from geography built into the app, so it works on a plane and in a country with no signal.

191 countries. 50 states and DC. Progress by continent, kept honest.

DATES WHEN YOU WANT THEM, NOT BEFORE

Nobody remembers which week they were in Portugal in 2011. Stamp it and move on. Add dates only to the trips you want counted — and when you do, Globelog counts them the way every authority counts them: the day you arrive and the day you leave are both days present. A trip from the 1st to the 10th is ten days, not nine.

Log the same week twice, or a layover inside a longer stay, and it still counts once. A calculator that adds up trip lengths gets that wrong in the direction that costs you.

THE COUNTS THAT MATTER

• Schengen 90/180 — days in the Schengen area across the rolling 180 days
• Any rolling 365 days, for wherever you are counting
• Any calendar year
• The peak your window reached, and the day it happened — a rolling window is worst at its peak, not today
• The date the window falls back under the line, assuming no more travel

Globelog reports what your own entries add up to. It is not legal or tax advice and it does not tell you whether you may enter or remain anywhere.

FREE, FOREVER

• The map, both layers, and every stamp
• Unlimited trips with dates and notes
• Days away by year, and your longest continuous stay
• Progress by continent
• The home screen widget

GLOBELOG PRO

• Schengen 90/180 and rolling 365-day windows
• The peak, and when the window clears
• CSV export of your whole record

PRIVACY, MEANT LITERALLY

Your trips live on this phone and are included in your own encrypted device backup. There is no account to create, no server holding your history, and no analytics SDK in the app. The only thing that ever leaves is a CSV you export yourself.

Travel Pins turns everywhere you have been into a collection of enamel pins.

YOUR PHOTOS NEVER LEAVE YOUR DEVICE
The entire map of the world ships inside the app. Your photos are read on your phone, matched on your phone, and never uploaded. Nothing is sent anywhere except, if you choose to make an account, the two-letter country codes you earned.

196 PINS, EVERY ONE DESIGNED BY HAND
Every UN member state, plus Vatican City, Palestine, Kosovo and Taiwan. Each pin is real 3D geometry - vector paths extruded into solids, plated in gold and filled with glass-hard enamel, lit by a studio environment. Metal walls stand proud of recessed colour, exactly the way a cloisonne pin is die-struck. Drag to spin one. Flick it and watch it settle.

No two look alike. There is no template: each pin gets its own frame, its own palette, and its own artwork - the Colosseum, Angel Falls, a Sepik haus tambaran, the Meroe pyramids.

EARN THEM, OR JUST GET THE ONE YOU WANT

A LEADERBOARD, IF YOU WANT ONE

results.description:
Explore the city before you arrive. Then walk it — and stamp it for real.

Urban Passport is one game with two halves. From the sofa, you pick a city and answer a short clue about a real place. Right or wrong, the story teaches you something true — and the place becomes a card in your collection. That is the homework nobody minds doing.

Then you go there. No turn-by-turn line telling you where to put your feet. You get a bearing and a distance — "40 m · north-east" — and finding the place is part of the game. Step inside the spot's radius and the stamp unlocks. It lands in your passport and it stays there.

BE YOUR OWN GUIDE
Every spot carries a real story, checked before it ships: street art and who painted it, architecture and why it looks like that, harbour history, hidden corners locals walk past. Read it before you travel, or read it standing right in front of the thing. Either way you arrive knowing something.

PICK YOUR LENS
Choose the categories you actually care about. Every category is its own collection and its own guide, so two people can walk the same city and come home with different passports.

A PASSPORT THAT IS YOURS
Stamps, cards and completed categories live in one profile that follows you from city to city. Finish a category and the page closes with a card you earned rather than bought.

TOGETHER, WITHOUT BEING TRACKED
Add friends with a QR or a short code. They see what you collect — never where you are right now. Stamp the same place as a friend and you both earn a shared Duo card.

ONE CODE, EVERYONE PLAYS
Start a game and share a single code. Friends, a family, a class or a hostel group join and play the same city live, on their own phones. Guests never pay and need no separate account — the host sets the game up. Group sizes run from a few friends up to large organised events.

BUILD YOUR OWN TOUR
Hosts can put together their own route in the Urban Passport host portal — your spots, your questions, your order — and then play it as a real game with the group in the app. Class trips, team days, family weekends, city rallies.

WHAT IT COSTS
Your first city is free, all of it. Studying from home is always free, everywhere — even in cities you have not opened yet. There is no subscription. Additional cities and larger group games are one-off purchases inside the app.

Hamburg is live with more than 90 spots. Berlin is growing. New cities keep arriving.

Location is used to verify you are at a place when you stamp it. Nothing scans in the background, and no server keeps a history of where you have been.

results.description:
Michi records where you have been, and how long you stayed.

Most travel apps count countries. Michi counts days. A city you passed through for an afternoon and a city you lived in for a year are not the same thing, and the map shows the difference.

A MAP MADE OF SQUARES The world as a grid, like a contribution graph. Every square is a piece of the world, and the deeper its colour, the longer you were there. Colour means time spent, not a place ticked off a list. Open a continent and the squares get finer, so a trip that was one square on the world map becomes a shape.

ADD A PLACE IN SECONDS Type a city, tap it, and it is saved. Nothing else is required. Dates, counted days and trips can come later, or never. Mark a city you lived in, and those days stay out of your travel total.

YEARS OF TRAVEL FROM YOUR PHOTOS Michi can suggest past trips from the date and place saved in your photos. It never reads the pictures themselves, and nothing is saved until you have checked it.

A PASSPORT YOU LEAF THROUGH Every country you have visited gets its own stamp, in the order you first went. The data page holds your totals, and Statistics shows your days by year, by continent and by country.

PLACES STILL TO COME Keep a list of places you want to visit, and plan trips you have not taken yet. A planned trip counts down to its start, and one switch shows or hides future places on the map. Star your favourites and mark the places you would like to go back to.

NOTHING IS INVENTED If you do not remember how long you stayed, Michi does not guess. An undated visit stays undated. It counts as visited, at the lightest shade, with no days made up for it, and days are never divided between cities on your behalf.

TRIPS, WHEN YOU WANT THEM Group visits into a trip, give it a name, dates and a note, or leave them loose. Both work.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN Two widgets: your square world map with your country count, and a countdown to your next trip.

SHARE A PICTURE, NOT A PROFILE Turn your world map, a continent, or a single trip into an image and send it wherever you like. Michi has no feed and no public profile, so a card you make is the only thing anyone else sees.

NO ACCOUNT, NO TRACKING There is nothing to create and nothing to sign in to. Michi runs no analytics and shows no ads. Your history stays on your iPhone, and syncs through your own iCloud account only if you switch that on. City search runs offline against data bundled with the app. What you type goes to Apple only if you tap Search Apple Maps to find a smaller town.

IN FOUR LANGUAGES Michi speaks English, German, Spanish and French, city names included: Munich is München on a German iPhone, and typing "Wien" finds Vienna on any phone.

Michi is an iPhone app and it works without a connection.

results.description:
Your national park journal now fills itself.

StampRescue finds the national parks, monuments, and physical passport stamp stations near you — and quietly turns the photos you already took into a record of every park you have ever visited.

YOUR JOURNAL FILLS ITSELF

Open the app and StampRescue checks your newest photos for parks you visited. When it finds one, a stamp drops into your journal with a little celebration. No check-ins, no typing, no forms.

• Automatic visit detection from your photo library
• A stamp animation the moment a new park is collected
• An optional notification when new stamps are waiting for you
• Your very first scan rebuilds years of past trips at once

Come home from a road trip, open StampRescue, and the parks are already there.

FIND PASSPORT STAMP STATIONS

The finder that started it all is still here, and still works offline.

• Search national parks, monuments, historic sites, and seashores
• Find the physical passport stamp stations reported at each site
• See distance, opening hours, and whether a station is open right now
• Browse an interactive map of parks near you or along your route
• Check park details before you drive out of your way

Know which park to visit and where to look for the cancellation stamp before you arrive.

NOTES FROM PEOPLE WHO WERE ACTUALLY THERE

New: every park page now carries notes left by other visitors — where the stamp desk really is, which entrance to use, what the rangers told them.

• Leave a note or a tip on any park you have visited
• Notes from people the app verified as visitors carry a badge
• Tap the heart on a park you love, and see what others love
• Reply to a note, or hide anyone you would rather not hear from
• Pick a display name, or leave it blank and post anonymously

Ask the people who just came back, not a search engine.

A BUCKET LIST YOU CAN FINISH

Pick the parks you dream of visiting and watch the number climb: 23 of 63 National Parks.

• Add all 63 National Parks to your list with one tap
• Or build your own list of monuments, seashores, and historic sites
• Visits you collect check themselves off automatically

SHARE THE STAMP

Every collected park can become a stamp-seal image with the park name and the date you were there — ready for Instagram, Messages, or anywhere you want to show off the trip.

MAKE YOUR OWN PHOTO STAMPS

Turn a favorite park photo into a personal Photo Stamp that combines the picture, the park name, your visit date, and a collectible stamp design. Perfect for the parks where you forgot to get the real cancellation stamp.

PLAN THE NEXT TRIP

Build a multi-park route in a sensible order for your itinerary, and get National Park Service alerts for closures and conditions before you go.

MADE FOR

• National park passport stamp collectors
• Cancellation stamp collectors
• Park visit trackers and journal keepers
• Road trippers working through the 63 National Parks
• Anyone with years of park memories buried in their camera roll

PRIVACY

Photo scanning happens entirely on your device. Your photos and their locations are never uploaded and never leave your phone — no account required.

Visit counts leave your device anonymously: which parks were visited on which days, with no name, no account, and no photos attached. That is what lets the app show how busy a park has been lately.

The only other thing that leaves your phone is what you deliberately post. A note or a heart is public and carries the display name you choose — leave it blank and you stay anonymous. Delete any note whenever you like, and Settings has a one-tap Delete my shared data that removes everything you have posted. Still no account, still no photos.

Find the park. Find the stamp. Remember the visit.

StampRescue is an independent travel companion and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Park Service or the Passport To Your National Parks program.

results.description:
Collectable is an app for keeping track of what you collect. What can you collect? Well, not necessarily stamps or coins (that works too), but more like the parks you’ve visited, the films you’ve watched, the cheeses you’ve tasted, the top 10 most visited monuments, etc.

You pick a collection and stamp what you’ve already done, with the date. You can also add a note and your own photo to remember it by. And when you put the last stamp on a collection, a little something happens on screen. It’s silly, but it feels good every time.

To get started, there are official collections, like the 63 US national parks, the most beautiful hikes in the world, Pixar movies, etc. And then there are the ones other people have published. You can browse all the collections by category, or by looking at other people’s favorites.

The list you’re looking for doesn’t exist? No problem, make it yourself. Type it in by hand, paste a list, or just give it a link to a web page and the app grabs the items by itself using Apple Intelligence. Then it’s up to you: keep it to yourself, or publish it so others can collect it too.

A collection in progress or finished? You can share where you’re at in an Instagram story.

You can also follow your friends and see what they stamp, send them a stamp or comment on their activity.

Your memory photos stay on your iPhone, or in your iCloud. Nothing is shared, visible to others or stored on Collectable servers.

You don’t need an account to look at collections. To start stamping, though, you’ll need one.

Collectable is free and has no ads. It’s made in France, just by me. No dev team, no UI/UX team, no big company. I love national parks and collecting everyday things. I’ve always wanted an app like this, for everything else.

If you have an idea or something doesn’t work, you can reach me at hi@collectable-app.com.

results.description:
Blazer is the golfer's passport. Every course you play earns a stamp, pressed with the date, the country and the holes — a record you keep for life, not a spreadsheet.

EVERY COURSE ON EARTH
More than 30,000 golf courses across 150 countries, from the Old Course at St Andrews to Pebble Beach to the nine-holer down the road. Search by name, or tap "find courses near me" and fill your passport in a minute.

STAMPS YOU EARN
Log a round and the stamp lands. Only the date is required — score, conditions and who you played with are there for the record if you want them. A wrongly logged round can be removed with one tap.

KEEP THE PAPER CARD
Photograph the scorecard and it is attached to that round for good. A passport holds the evidence, and the card in your back pocket is the evidence. Yours only — scorecards are private to you.

YOUR WORLD MAP
Every course you have played turns green. Every course you want turns gold. Tap a pin to open the course.

YOUR BUCKET LIST, TURNED INTO TRIPS
Star the courses you want to play. Blazer groups the ones close enough to play in one trip — five courses within forty miles — and turns them into a plan.

CREWS AND POLLS
Golf is not a solo sport. Start a crew, send the six-character code on WhatsApp, and settle where you are going with a poll whose options are real courses. The winner becomes the trip. Crews, chat and polls are free forever.

BADGES FOR GOING FURTHER
Countries, continents, the Open rota, the Blazer 100, and the mile spread between your two furthest courses. Travel-flavored, never a prestige score.

WHAT'S IN THE BAG
Your clubs and kit, typeset like a tour player's spec card, with a packing checklist to tick off before you go.

FIXED BY GOLFERS
Wrong hole count? Course closed? Suggest a correction from any course page. Members fix our data faster than anyone.

SHARE THE CARD
A passport card with your stamps and counts, made for the group chat. Your scores and notes stay private.

BLAZER PRO
Blazer Pro is here, as a monthly or yearly subscription or a single lifetime payment. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings. Everything you log stays yours.

Blazer is not a GPS rangefinder and does not track your swing. Plenty of good apps do that, and they sit happily beside this one.

Plan your next Schengen stay with your travel history in one place. After unlocking Stay90, add your past trips to see your remaining allowance under the 90/180 rule and check future dates before booking.

THE 90 DAY RULE THAT TRIPS PEOPLE UP
The 90 day rule limits most visa-free visitors — UK, US, Canadian, and Australian citizens — to 90 days in any rolling 180-day period. Overstay, even by accident, and you risk fines, future entry bans, or removal at the border. Stay90 tracks your allowance precisely so you always know where you stand.

TRACK YOUR SCHENGEN ALLOWANCE
Add entry and exit dates for every Schengen visit. Stay90 calculates your rolling window in real time — no spreadsheet, no guessing. Both the arrival day and departure day count as full days, matching the official EU Short-Stay Calculator.

SEE YOUR STATUS AT A GLANCE
The Dashboard shows your remaining days, when your window resets, and how long you could stay if you entered today. One number. Zero confusion.

PLAN FUTURE TRIPS
Before you book flights or accommodation, enter your planned dates and Stay90 tells you instantly:
• Whether the trip fits inside the 90/180 rule
• Peak days used at any point during your stay
• Latest safe exit date — the last day you can legally leave
• Must-leave-by date if the trip is too long
• Earliest possible re-entry after your window resets

EXISTING USERS
Existing purchasers keep their unlocked features. Users of earlier versions retain their previously available trip log and current calculations; future-trip planning requires the one-time purchase. Restore Purchase is available from Help on the purchase screen.

BUILT FOR
– UK travellers visiting Europe after Brexit
– US, Canadian, and Australian frequent Europe visitors
– Digital nomads and remote workers based outside the EU
– Retirees and seasonal visitors planning long stays
– Anyone who needs a fast, trustworthy answer before booking

LOCAL AND PRIVATE
Trip dates and travel details stay on your device. No account. No cloud sync. No developer-collected travel data. Optional anonymous product analytics can be turned off in Settings → Privacy.

DISCLAIMER
Stay90 is a personal planning aid only. It does not provide legal or immigration advice. Schengen eligibility depends on your nationality, visas, residence permits, bilateral arrangements, and current regulations. Always verify your eligibility using the official EU Short-Stay Calculator or your national border authority before travelling.

Some apps log where you went. Coffer remembers what you brought back.

For every trip, pack a digital trunk and fill it with the small things that made it real: the boarding pass you saved, the postcard you mailed home, the magnet from the bakery on the corner, the strange snack you couldn't translate the wrapper of. Each souvenir becomes a "keepsake", catalogued with a photo, a location, a price, a date, a note. Each trip becomes a coffer of memory.

• Boarding passes and train tickets get their own ticket-stub card, with from / to, departure time, code and seat.
• Scan a paper ticket with your camera and Coffer fills in the fields for you. It uses Apple's on-device VisionKit, so the image never leaves your phone.

Free to start: pack your first five keepsakes into as many trunks as you like, with your Atlas, Passport and sync across your devices. Coffer Plus is a one-time unlock, no subscription. It adds unlimited keepsakes, camera ticket scanning, your Year in Review, and exporting your collection as a file. results.description:
The 九州八十八湯 (Kyushu 88) is one of Japan's great bathing challenges: soak in 88 hot springs across Kyushu, from grand old Beppu bathhouses to mountain baths with no signal and no signage in English.

Kyuhachi puts the whole challenge in one app. Every eligible onsen (around 155 of them) with its hours, prices, access and spring quality. A map that shows what's near you. A stamp book that fills as you go. In English and Japanese, and all of it works offline.

It is a personal, fan-made app, not affiliated with the 九州八十八湯 organisation or 88onsen.com.

EVERY ONSEN IN ONE PLACE
No more tabs and screenshots. Each onsen page carries the address, phone number, opening hours, admission fee and spring quality, kept in sync with the official listings. Search the catalog, browse by prefecture, heart your favorites.

SEE WHAT'S NEAR YOU
Open the map and pick your next bath by where you actually are, not by where the guidebook thinks you'll be. In a valley with no bars, the map, the list and every detail page still open: the catalog lives on your phone.

A BOOK THAT FILLS UP
Every visit presses a stamp into your Spaport. Log the date, the price, how you got there, a photo, or just tick the onsen off and get back in the water. Pages fill in the order you bathe, so by stamp 88 the book is the story of the trip.

PICK YOUR RULES
Do it by car, by public transport, by bicycle, or entirely on foot. Each is its own challenge with its own bronze, silver and gold tiers, and every bath you log moves you up the rank ladder from 見習い to 泉人.

BRING YOUR OWN ROUTE
Planning the trip in another app? Import the GPS track (.gpx, .kml, .tcx), attach it to a challenge, and see which onsens sit along the line. Finder then looks ahead on the route for convenience stores, supermarkets, roadside stations, campsites and hotels, so the next stop is sorted before you need it.

AREA GUIDES
Short reads on the onsen regions of Kyushu: the local food, the produce worth carrying home, the sights, and the history behind the water. Enough to tell you whether the detour is worth it.

THE NUMBERS
Pace and a projected finish date, prefectures covered, visits over time, how you travelled, what you have spent and what finishing will cost, and how you rated every bath along the way.

WORKS WHERE THERE'S NO SIGNAL
Record the visit at the door, signal or not. It syncs the next time you're connected.

ENGLISH AND JAPANESE
The whole app follows your device language. Onsen names stay in the original Japanese, with readings alongside so you can say them out loud when asking for directions.

YOUR RECORDS STAY YOURS
Your visits, photos and notes are yours alone; no other user ever sees them. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Delete your account any time, from inside the app, and everything goes with it.

Free, with no in-app purchases.


Onsen information comes from 88onsen.com and is provided as is. Details change, especially in small places, so please confirm opening hours, prices and access with the onsen before you travel. Kyuhachi is an independent app and has no connection to the 九州八十八湯 organisation or to 88onsen.com.

results.description:
Schengen 90/180 Tracker helps you calculate Schengen days left, check future Europe trips, and find your latest safe exit and earliest re-entry date without spreadsheets or manual counting.

The rule sounds simple, but it is easy to miscalculate: every day you spend in the Schengen Area is checked against the previous 180 days. A short trip from months ago can still affect your next entry, your current stay, or the date you should leave.

Add your past trips, current stay, and future travel plans. The app shows the numbers that matter before you book, travel, or return to Europe.

If you travel on a short-stay visa, your visa sticker carries its own validity dates, authorised stay and entry count. The app checks a planned trip against those and the 90/180 rule at once.

EES AND ETIAS

Since April 2026, the EU Entry/Exit System (EES) records your entries and exits automatically instead of passport stamps, but it flags overstays at the border rather than helping you plan ahead. ETIAS, arriving later in 2026, is a travel authorisation: it lets you in, but it does not change your 90/180-day limit. Know your numbers before you book, not at the border.

KEY FEATURES

• Schengen days left
See how many days you have used and how many remain in your current 180-day window, with clear colour-coded status: safe, low days, at limit, or possible overstay.

• 90/180 rule calculator
Track your stay allowance using the rolling Schengen short-stay rule. Entry and exit days both count, just like in the official EU short-stay calculator method. Past trips respect the exact dates Croatia, Bulgaria and Romania began applying the short-stay rules.

• Short-stay visa check
Enter the validity dates, DURATION OF STAY and number of entries printed on your Type C visa sticker, and check a planned trip against your visa and the 90/180 rule together. Transit visas and limited territorial validity are not covered. Visa details you enter are not saved.

• Smart alerts (Pro)
Get notified before you reach 10, 5, 3, 1 and 0 days left, so the limit never surprises you.

• Calculation breakdown
See exactly which days count toward your 90, trip by trip, and which days have dropped out of the window.

• Save planned trips (Pro)
Check any future itinerary for free with the visa calculator, then save it to your timeline as a planned trip with Pro.

• Latest safe exit and earliest re-entry
See the latest date that keeps your current stay within the allowance, and the earliest date you can return after using it.

• Trip calendar
Review past, current, and planned Schengen trips in a calendar view.

• iCloud backup (Pro)
Keep a private backup of your trip history in your iCloud account and restore it on a new iPhone.

• Unlimited free tracking
Save unlimited past trips and current stays for free. No account required; your travel history is stored on your device.

BUILT FOR

Tourists, digital nomads, remote workers, snowbirds, expats, business travellers, and anyone who visits Europe often.

WHY IT HELPS

The 90/180 rule changes every day because the 180-day reference window keeps moving. That means your allowance can change even when you do not add a new trip.

• How many Schengen days do I have left?
• Can I take this future trip?
• When should I leave, and when can I come back?

IMPORTANT NOTICE

Schengen 90/180 Tracker is an independent travel planning tool. It is not an official EU, Schengen, border, visa, immigration, or government app, and it is not affiliated with EES or ETIAS.

Calculation results are for informational planning only. They do not create a legal right to enter, remain in, or return to the Schengen Area. Your situation may depend on your nationality, visa type, residence permit, bilateral agreements, and border decisions.

Always confirm your travel situation with official sources or qualified advice before making important travel decisions.

results.description:
Stop tracking your tax residency in a spreadsheet.

Residency counts your days in every tax jurisdiction you enter, checks them against that jurisdiction’s own rules and its own tax year, and keeps the evidence behind each day. Open the app to see how many days you have left, and how fast you are using them.

EACH COUNTRY, ON ITS OWN TAX YEAR
Most day counters run every country from January to December. The UK tax year runs from 6 April, so for anyone living between the UK and the US, a calendar count gets the UK wrong. Residency counts each place on its own year: the UK from 6 April, the US, Portugal and Spain from 1 January, the UAE over any 12 months and the Schengen area over any 180 days. The home screen shows the dates each count covers.

A country and a US state are separate tests with separate rules. The US Substantial Presence Test and the UK Statutory Residence Test ties are each modelled from the authority’s own source. Florida counts upward: becoming a resident is the goal, and the app counts toward it.

YOUR LOCATION NEVER LEAVES THE PHONE
Your coordinates become a country name and are then deleted. Nothing is uploaded unless you ask. Your day record stays on this phone and can be protected by an encrypted backup file you export with a passphrase.

MISSING DAYS ARE NEVER INVENTED
When tracking stops, the count is shown as a range until you close the gap. A stay with an arrival and no departure is one anchored day, not an invented month.

YEARS OF YOUR PAST TRAVEL, WITHOUT TYPING A DATE
Photograph your passport pages and the stamps are read on the phone. Your photo library, boarding passes, a spreadsheet, and the official US travel record for visitors all import without manual entry.

PROOF FOR YOUR ACCOUNTANT
Every counted day names what it rests on: a stamp, a location fix, a boarding pass, or nothing. Export the record as a document when they ask for it.

A RESIDENT PARTNER CUTS YOUR ALLOWANCE
Partners and dependants can share an encrypted snapshot of their day counts behind a code they control, so you can read their counts without receiving location records.

Residency is a record-keeping aid, not tax advice. Check your position with your adviser.
